annotations.title: Host a remote image/video/audio so a project can use it

description: Fetch a remote media URL (image/video/audio) and HOST it on Clipkit, returning a stable asset_url to put in an element's `url`. Use this so the project's media survives — the original link may rot, be private, or block hotlinking. Anonymous projects allow up to 5 hosted assets / 100 MB total / 50 MB per file; when the limit is hit, tell the user to open the project (open_in_editor) and sign in to add more. Requires project_id.

filename.description: Optional display name for the asset.

project_id.description: Which project to act on — the id returned by create_project / set_project / create_promo / load_project. ALWAYS pass it once a project exists in this conversation; omitting it on a build tool creates a brand-new project. (Omit only on the local stdio server working a single project.)

url.description: A public http(s) URL to an image, video, or audio file.

name: ingest_asset
